sessionEnd.comment: Mirrors Claude Code's Stop hook (.claude/hooks/check-touched-related-files.sh) — surfaces architecture docs whose related-files were touched without the doc itself being updated. See .github/hooks/README.md for context.

Mirrors Claude Code's Stop hook (.claude/hooks/check-touched-lint.sh) — runs spell / markdown / JSON lint on changed files so the agent sees failures before pre-push surfaces them. See .github/hooks/README.md for context.
